pr_title: Editor: add Resource counter and measurement info into Area Selection tab
pr_body:
Supersedes #20175
Closes:  #18222



![d2k-2024-01-24T161913831Z](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/assets/100044015/60f303e5-8135-48be-8600-e393c6c6f7ee)

Know issue:
Resource counter dont work on shell map.
pr_comments:
> Resource counter dont work on shell map.

That's because resources have no value on the shellmaps, so the silos won't fill, causing the harvesters/miners to stop at some point. I would say it is WAI. Tho i guess Refineries could be edited to use `UseStorage: false` or `DiscardExcessResources: true` instead to achive the same thing without breaking this.

Edit: `ShowTicks: false` as well.

issue_context.title: Map Editor - Distance Measure tool
issue_context.body:
Shouldn't be hard to implement, the only issue I see is the UX of it.

Would be very useful to measure cliff gaps, distances between resources, spawns, capturable locations and all that, without the need to do trigonometrics in one's head.
comments:
https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/20175 is sufficient to what I had in mind.

the only thing I think might be better and more specific is if the distance tool highlighted (the same as the copy/paste tool does) the distance between the two cells and any cells that the line intersected on top of giving the diagonal length,, rather than highlighting a whole box like the aforementioned tool does.

review_comments: If you subscribe to an event you should also unsubscribe. That is usually done is a Disposed() method
I'm wondering wether diagonal is even useful. It's kinda redundant

If players spawns are in corners and you wanna mesure distance from spawn point to the center. Or Distance of anything from anything. I use it a lot. 
But problem is that Diagonal length doenst mach Cell length.  And I dont know how to fix this.
![Snímka obrazovky (40)](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/assets/100044015/7b2a47d0-1b3a-4161-9291-114bb367c841)
ah I see, it can be used as a ruler. This is probably the better solution than adding an actual ruler tool
